records.title: Locate, Steer, and Improve: A Practical Survey of Actionable Mechanistic Interpretability in Large Language Models
records.reason: The methods are interpretability interventions and diagnostics, not compute, memory, latency, quantization, cache, or serving optimizations. The adaptive-expert lineage link is not a technical connection.

records.title: Wait, Wait, Wait... Why Do Reasoning Models Loop?
records.reason: The paper explains why reasoning models loop and discusses temperature as a partial stopgap, but does not present a robust inference-time optimization method; synthetic-to-real transfer remains limited.

records.title: Benchmarking LLM Tool-Use in the Wild
records.reason: This is a benchmark of real-world tool-use behavior. Its relationship to KV/cache and serving efficiency is indirect, and the paper does not establish a cache or runtime optimization.

records.title: DataFlow: An LLM-Driven Framework for Unified Data Preparation and Workflow Automation in the Era of Data-Centric AI
records.reason: DataFlow is an LLM-driven data-preparation and workflow-automation framework, but the primary text does not establish model-serving efficiency or KV reuse.

records.title: MedSynapse-V: Bridging Visual Perception and Clinical Intuition via Latent Memory Evolution
records.reason: MedSynapse-V uses latent-memory evolution for clinical video understanding, but the full text does not establish KV-cache compression or general inference serving savings.
